description: Stardew Valley mod adding a magic box that transmutes items.
readme:
![The text 'Metamorphic Cube' on a menu banner. Below is in-game art of a large
egg and a witch hat, with arrows pointing in and out of a strange blue box and
over to a void egg.](images/hero.png)

This magical machine can transmute items into different ones! Combine weaker
things to make them stronger, increase item quality, and more... maybe even
sequence break a little, as a treat!

## The Cube

The Metamorphic Cube is a magical device that can transform items placed within
it. Simply open the box, insert a valid combination of items, and press the
Transmute button. Your cube will work on the contents until they're all ready;
then you open the box and take them out!

Your cube can transmute many things at once (within the limits of its inventory
space). While it works, it will pulse, much like other machines. However, it
won't show a floating output balloon, like, say, a keg would: once it stops,
the new items will simply be inside.

The cube can be pickaxed/axed/hoed in order to unplace it; this will safely
eject all of its contents. This will work even if it is transmuting (you will
get the untransmuted contents), so it is an effective way to cancel a
transmutation.

## How To Obtain

After you've made some progress in the game (at least three Community Center
rooms or Joja community upgrades), everybody's friend the Wizard will send you
a Cube in the mail. You can also get the crafting recipe for it at the Desert
Festival, from the egg vendor.

## Recipes

Unfortunately, the Wizard won't give you any recipes for the Cube right away,
so you'll have to experiment until he sends along the recipe book. When you use
the book, it will show you all available recipes, one per page.

Keep in mind that the recipe book, too, is magical, and it won't reveal a
recipe that isn't available. You should check it from time to time to see if
new ones have appeared!

## I Lost My Cube!

Because there is a crafting recipe for the Cube, you cannot buy it back from
the Lost Items shop in the Secret Woods. You'll have to obtain the recipe and
craft a new one (or spawn it in, of course).

If you manage to lose the recipe book, that *can* be purchased at the Lost
Items shop, for the customary 10,000g.

## Installation

This mod has no dependencies except for [SMAPI](https://smapi.io). Just unzip
the mod into your Mods folder, and enjoy, as usual.

## Compatibility

Not known to conflict with other mods, as it's quite self-contained.

This mod stores its recipes in a data asset, and any mod is free to add its own
recipes to the data in order to expand on the Cube's powers. Please forgive me,
but I do not have an author guide available at this time.

I have tested the basics in multiplayer, but I haven't been exhaustive. Bug
reports are welcome!
